supported_precision.rule: Gold supported claims predicted as supported divided by all predicted supported claims

supported_recall.rule: Gold supported claims predicted as supported divided by total gold supported claims

supported_f1.rule: Harmonic mean of supported precision and recall

non_supported_far.rule: Proportion of non-supported claims falsely accepted into the supported class

contradiction_far.rule: Contradicted claims falsely accepted as supported

partially_supported_far.rule: Partially supported claims falsely accepted as supported

unsupported_far.rule: Unsupported claims falsely accepted as supported

false_rejection_rate.rule: Gold supported claims rejected or downgraded into unsupported/contradicted/not_evaluated

not_evaluated_rate.rule: Claims where verifier deferred decision due to low confidence or ambiguity

safe_presentation_compliance.rule: Claims where non-supported claims are never predicted as supported

answer_level_false_verification_rate.rule: Whole answers receiving 'verified_supported' badge when containing gold non-supported content
answer_level_false_verification_rate.qualification_note: Under multi-claim aggregation with fail-closed presentation rules, answers with partial support receive 'qualified_answer', contradictions receive 'rejected_answer'. However, in isolated single-claim answers without other safeguards, the 5 claim-level false acceptances would directly propagate to verified_supported.
